mapper.select: select g.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_goods_apply g left join sys_user u on g.user_id = u.id order by g.id desc
select g.*, u.real_name as user_name from oa_goods_apply g left join sys_user u on g.user_id = u.id where g.user_id = #{userId} order by g.id desc
mapper.insert: insert into oa_goods_apply(user_id, goods_name, quantity, reason, status) values(#{userId}, #{goodsName}, #{quantity}, #{reason}, #{status})
mapper.update: update oa_goods_apply set status = #{status}, approver_id = #{approverId}, approve_opinion = #{approveOpinion}, approve_time = now() where id = #{id}
